title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Per-Item Removal Fee by Value of the Delivered Purchase
content:
The per-item removal fee for old appliances on a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment follows the merchandise on the purchase being delivered, counted as the amounts of its sale lines less the amounts of its returned lines, as the purchase's lines under Northgate Purchases & Returns show them.

| Merchandise on the purchase being delivered (sale lines less returned lines) | Per-item removal fee |
|---|---|
| $2500.00 or more | $15.00 an item |
| $1500.00 or more but under $2500.00 | $20.00 an item |
| Under $1500.00 | The service level's per-item haul-away fee |

## Both sides of each band

| Merchandise | Per-item removal fee |
|---|---|
| $2500.00 | $15.00 |
| $2499.99 | $20.00 |
| $1500.00 | $20.00 |
| $1499.99 | The service level's per-item haul-away fee |

**Hypothetical purchase.** Sale lines of $2700.00 with a returned line of $300.00 leave $2400.00 of merchandise: $20.00 an item.
